Hi Lena / Arjun —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our notes, we'd like to kick off a short discovery + demo for StelloTech to surface the performance/ops fit and get engineering/security/procurement aligned. Suggested attendees from Redwood: me (AE), Stephanie Nguyen (Solutions Engineer), and my manager Marcus Lin (for procurement/contract touchpoints as needed). From StelloTech, could you confirm the engineering lead and security/procurement contacts you want on the call?

Proposed 45-minute blocks (all PDT):
- Tue 5/5 10:00–10:45
- Wed 5/6 10:00–10:45
- Wed 5/6 15:00–15:45

Agenda (attached: discovery-agenda.docx):
1) Quick goals and success metrics (5m)
2) Architecture & data flow (15m)
3) Security/compliance questions + network model (10m)
4) Demo & next steps (15m)

If none of these work, share two windows that do and we’ll follow up with a calendar invite.

Thanks,
